astrollm ONNX-inference code + exported model, vendored for OriginStack's
--astrollm feature. torch-free: the exported model runs under onnxruntime, so
this snapshot needs neither torch nor astropy.

NOTE (2026-09-06): this directory is now a PROVENANCE SNAPSHOT ONLY, not on
the runtime path. --astrollm runs in-process from src/astrollm_infer.py (a
numpy/scipy port of infer_onnx.py + data/imageops.py + data/shape_features.py,
no OpenCV) against src/data/astrollm.onnx (byte-identical to
checkpoints/model.onnx here). These files are kept so a future re-sync can
diff against upstream; see README.md for the re-sync steps.

source repo : https://github.com/hd152/astrollm
branch      : improve-training-and-tooling
commit      : abd1f5f67bdb3c51a54d6d1e28f2429df76d2d08
vendored on : 2026-09-06
vendored by : scripted minimal-set copy (ONNX inference path only)

Included (the upstream reference for src/astrollm_infer.py's numpy/scipy port):
  infer_onnx.py                 <- torch-free entry point (--model / --image / --json)
  data/imageops.py              <- percentile stretch + resize/center-crop + background correction (cv2+numpy)
  data/shape_features.py        <- comet shape-gate features for infer_onnx.py's category head (cv2+numpy)
  checkpoints/model.onnx        <- exported model (epoch 15, SSL-pretrained + fine-tuned; ~10 MB;
                                   byte-identical to src/data/astrollm.onnx)

Model heads meaningful for this checkpoint (baked into the ONNX metadata's
`tasks`): reject, quality, category, exposure, sky_brightness,
stray_light_gradient. `category` is a 4-class head -- galaxy, nebula,
star_cluster, comet (the earlier 7-bucket taxonomy with planet/star/other is
gone). `exposure` is now a 7-class classifier (5/10/15/20/25/30/40 s) rather
than the old `log_exposure` regression head. infer_onnx.py also carries
dormant `trailing` / `background_grid` code paths from later upstream commits;
this checkpoint's graph has neither head, so they never fire.

NOT vendored: infer.py (torch), export_onnx.py (dev-only), pretrain_ssl.py,
cull.py, models/, data/cache.py, data/dataset.py, data/light_stats.py,
data/manifest.py, train.py, data/*.jsonl, configs/, tests/, the .pt checkpoints.

infer_onnx.py handles TIFF/PNG/JPG only -- it refuses FITS (no astropy debayer).
The in-process port (src/astrollm_infer.py::_load_image_any) debayers a raw
.fits light itself and feeds the array straight to the model -- no temp file.
Re-sync steps: see README.md.
